messages:
santosh: Hey team — starting onboarding for Nova-6B (openweights v0.9). License PDF attached in drive. It looks like a research-only / non-commercial + no-redistribute combo. Quick Qs: can we serve this on Hosted API? can we quantize & ship to Dedicated or Private? what attribution text should we show?

priya_legal: Thanks. Research-only typically forbids commercial offering of the model itself. Exposing via Hosted API to paying customers is risky — likely violates non-commercial. Need to see exact clause.

marco: to clarify, Dedicated means we host the model on our infra (customers call our endpoints). Private means we hand artifacts or a deployable package to the customer.

priya_legal: Right. If we only run the model in our hosted infra (Dedicated/Hosted) and never redistribute the weights, that may be ok for internal/commercial use — but many "research-only" licenses also forbid "use for models offering a service". We need license text check. For Private/on-prem where we ship weights or an installable bundle, that’s definitely redistribution and problematic.

ellie: what about quantization? we often produce 4-bit artifacts to improve perf. Does that count as redistribution if we store and give them to a customer?

priya_legal: Modified weights are still a derivative/redistribution in most cases. If license prohibits redistribution, you cannot provide quantized weights to customers. You can run quantized weights in-host (i.e., we do the quantization internally and serve) if the license allows running the model for commercial/internal purposes. But again — many research-only licenses forbid commercial deployments entirely.

marco: ok. For Dedicated customers who sign enterprise contracts: we sometimes give them model snapshots for their dedicated cluster (they have access). That sounds unsafe.

priya_legal: Yes — avoid providing any binary/model blobs. Instead offer the inference service behind our API and document the license clearly. For on-prem/private offers, negotiate a commercial license with the model authors.

ellie: outputs/embeddings — any restrictions? Some licences forbid using model outputs for training.

priya_legal: Outputs are generally permitted unless the license specifies otherwise. Check for clauses like "no commercial use of outputs" or "no derivative works". Also check attribution requirements and export-control language.

santosh: there's also an export-control note in the repo README about dual-use and 'US export controls may apply'. How do we handle that?

priya_legal: Export-control is orthogonal. If the model or its weights are flagged as EAR/ITAR or country-restricted, we need to restrict deployment regions and enforce customer screening. Engineering should add region gating and deploy-time checks. Ops to coordinate.

marco: for immediate onboarding, what's the recommended path?

priya_legal: Short checklist for Nova-6B onboarding:
1) Legal: full license review (we'll attach annotated doc).
2) Product: decide whether this is for internal eval vs customer-facing.
3) Engineering: if allowed, only host inference in our infra; do NOT export weights or quantized artifacts to customers.
4) Registry: add license metadata + required attribution string to model registry entry.
5) Ops/Security: enforce region gating if export restrictions noted.
6) If customers require on-prem or redistribution, negotiate a commercial license with model owners.

santosh: can you propose a default attribution text we should show in Console / API metadata?

priya_legal: Suggested minimal attribution (put in model card + footer):

```
Model: Nova-6B (Nova AI Lab)
License: Research-Only v0.9
Attribution: "This service uses Nova-6B developed by Nova AI Lab. Use is subject to the Research-Only v0.9 license: https://nova.ai/licenses/research-v0.9"
```

priya_legal: Add a link to the original repo and the annotated legal note. If license requires additional wording (e.g., mention of non-commercial use), include that verbatim.

deploy-bot: license-scan result for model nova-6b: FOUND: research-only, no-redistribute, export-warning. FLAG: legal-review-required.

marco: thanks — I'll pause the onboarding and add the license metadata in the registry. Santosh, can you update the quickstart to mark this as "internal/eval only" until legal confirms?

santosh: will do. tagging @priya_legal for the annotated review. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
